lines.text: After leaving Kadesh, the whole congregation of Israel came to Mount Hor, near the border of Edom.
The LORD told Moses and Aaron that Aaron would not enter the land because they rebelled at Meribah.
The LORD told Moses to take Aaron and Eleazar up Mount Hor and put Aaron's priestly garments on Eleazar.
Moses and Aaron climbed Mount Sinai in sight of the congregation, and Aaron died there on top of the mountain.
Moses and Eleazar came down, and when Israel saw Aaron had died, they mourned for him sixty days.
